metadata.description: Local-first accounting and tax skills for AI agents — statement extraction, bank reconciliation, tax return review, variance analysis, journal entry testing, K-1 extraction, payroll reconciliation, audit sampling, three-way match, and fixed asset tie-out

plugins.name: cpa-skills
plugins.description: Ten skills for accountants, tax professionals, controllers, and auditors: convert PDF bank statements to Excel with a completeness proof, reconcile bank statements to the general ledger, review tax returns against a checklist with evidence for every item tested, run year-over-year variance analysis with enforced explanation quality, scan a full journal entry population for anomalies, extract and foot Schedule K-1 data, reconcile payroll register to 941s to W-2/W-3 to the GL, select reproducible audit samples with MUS and stratified methods, perform a three-way match across POs, invoices and receipts, and tie the fixed asset register to the depreciation schedule and return. Every skill runs entirely on the local machine and refuses to deliver a workpaper that does not tie.
